name: Gymcatch
summary: Booking and customer management software for fitness studios, trainers and wellness businesses, with unlimited bookings and clients on one plan.
best_for: Personal trainers, fitness studios and wellness businesses that want simple class booking and client management at one flat monthly price
skip_if: you run a large multi-site chain, you need a US-based payment processor, you want a free plan, or you want a tool we have tested ourselves
honest_knock: Card processing fees are charged on top of the subscription and we could not find the rates. There is no free plan or yearly price on the page. We found no dated changelog.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Gymcatch · From £10 +VAT per month with 1 month free, no card
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-16 on gymcatch.com/pricing, British pounds a month) Gymcatch is booking and customer management software for fitness and wellness businesses. It costs from £10 + VAT a month with the first month free. The pricing page says no credit card is required, but the registration form read on 19 November 2026 has a Card details field and a first payment date a month later. The plan has unlimited bookings, customers and team members. Bolt-ons cost £2 + VAT each a month and are included in the free month. Online payments run through GymcatchPay or Stripe, and processing fees are not included. The page says you can cancel at any time. We have not paid for a plan.

exit_test.what: No account was made; the registration form of Gymcatch has a Card details field and nothing was filled in or sent. We entered no card, sent nothing and made no account, so the product was not tested. Account and start: no account was made. The pages were looked at in an own Chrome tab on 19 November 2026; the registration form is loaded with JavaScript; nothing was filled in and nothing was sent. The dossier name is Gymcatch (gymcatch.com) and the review is on OSM (osm/gymcatch-review.html). Pricing page https://gymcatch.com/business/pricing/: Gymcatch, from, EUR 14, per month, with 1 month free, the button Get started, and below it 1 month free. No credit card required. Cancel anytime. Registration form https://portal.gymcatch.com/register: Create a new business account. The Gymcatch business plan is EUR 14 per month after an initial 1 month free. Any bolt-ons are charged in addition and included in your free month. The sections are Personal information, Business details and Billing information. Under Billing information: If you have a code please enter it here; Your first payment is due to be taken on 19-12-2026 and you can cancel your subscription at any time before then without being charged.; the line I am authorised by the above business to sign up to Gymcatch and accept the Gymcatch Terms of Use and Data and Privacy Policy.; and the line I authorise Gymcatch to send instructions to the financial institution that issued my card to take payments from my card account in accordance with the terms of my agreement with Gymcatch. After these come the field Card details and the button Get started. Conclusion from the text: the form has a card field and an authorisation to charge the card, while the pricing page says No credit card required. We did not enter a card and did not send anything. Not tested: the core function and the cancelling route; only the sentence on the form that you can cancel before 19-12-2026 was read. Screenshots: none were made; there is no image to check or mask. Clean up: no account was made, so nothing needs deleting; the own tab was closed. No kit records were entered.

sessions.what: We looked at the pricing page and the registration form of Gymcatch on 19 November 2026 and stopped at the form. The pricing page says EUR 14 a month with 1 month free and "No credit card required", but the form has a Card details field and a line that authorises Gymcatch to charge the card, with a first payment date of 19-12-2026. We entered no card, sent nothing and made no account, so the product was not tested.
findings: Pricing page, 19 Nov 2026: "1 month free. No credit card required. Cancel anytime." The form behind its Get started button has a Card details field under Billing information.

The form says "Your first payment is due to be taken on 19-12-2026 and you can cancel your subscription at any time before then without being charged." We read this and did not try the cancelling route.

The form also has a line in which you authorise Gymcatch to send instructions to the issuer of your card to take payments. Nothing was ticked or sent, so we do not know whether the form can be sent without a card.
not_tested: Not tested: the booking features and the rest of the product; the form was not completed.
Whether the form works without a card, the card processing fees, the bolt-on prices and cancelling.
sessions.note: Findings as written up after the session; no pass/fail per task was scored.
